entries.clue: Paid-for right to travel, printed out or shown on a phone
Rock serpent of these stories, thirty feet of patient coil
At the controls, and the voice that welcomes you aboard
Zipped carry-on stowed in the locker above your head
Velvet-footed black panther who bought the boy's life with a fresh-killed bull
Heavy horned grazer the boy was set to mind once he lived among men
Molten flood that pours down a mountainside and hardens into black rock
Indonesian island whose 1883 blast was heard thousands of miles away
Long tear in the earth's surface, or a falling-out between old friends
Lame man-eating tiger, sworn foe of the boy the wolves brought up
Sudden violent outburst, of a mountain or of spots on a teenage chin
22C, perhaps: yours alone for the whole journey
